taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Secrets Manager resource-policy and version access across principals
controls.source_trace: Evaluate the actual principal and resource/condition context, then distinguish metadata read, secret-value read and changing a version/staging label.
controls.implementation_branch: Resolve the requested secret ARN and VersionId/VersionStage, including which versions a policy actually permits. Cross-account access can require both secret and customer-managed KMS-key authority. A readable policy or a GetSecretValue denial caused by KMS does not prove another actor can retrieve plaintext; preserve the blocked edge and inspect rotation identities separately.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a secret containing only an owned synthetic marker; compare the intended role with another owned role and inspect the exact requested version.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: List/describe permission is not GetSecretValue authority, and a KMS denial must not be attributed to a different resource policy.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Narrow effective value/version authority and retest allowed retrieval, restricted principals and version lifecycle.
